description: Nucleoid builds a live monitoring record beside a frozen reading with optional explicit-property commas
code:
reading = 12
unit = "kPa"
monitor = {reading: reading unit: unit active: true}
initial = {reading: reading.value unit: unit.value}
assert(monitor.reading, 12)
reading = 18
unit = "Pa"
assert(monitor.reading, 18)
assert(monitor.unit, "Pa")
assert(initial.reading, 12)
assert(initial.unit, "kPa")
monitor.unit

description: Nucleoid nests shipment records while preserving list and function-call commas
code:
def label(zone, serial) => zone + serial
serial = "17"
shipment = {header: {kind: "parcel" ready: true} items: [{code: label("A", serial) count: 2}, {code: label("B", serial) count: 1}] state: "open"}
assert(shipment.header.ready, true)
assert(shipment.items[0].code, "A17")
assert(shipment.items[1].count, 1)
serial = "18"
assert(shipment.items[0].code, "A18")
assert(shipment.items[1].code, "B18")

description: Nucleoid replaces equivalent quoted and numeric explicit keys without changing named state writes
code:
amount = 4
record = {1: "old" "1": "latest" amount: amount state: "open"}
assert(record["1"], "latest")
assert(record.amount, 4)
record.state = "closed"
assert(record.state, "closed")
amount = 9
assert(record.amount, 9)
record["1"]

description: Nucleoid keeps independent class receiver reads inside compact explicit payload records
code:
class Gauge
north = Gauge()
south = Gauge()
north.reading = 2
south.reading = 5
$Gauge.payload = {reading: $Gauge.reading kind: "pressure" ready: true}
assert(north.payload.reading, 2)
assert(south.payload.reading, 5)
north.reading = 7
assert(north.payload.reading, 7)
assert(south.payload.reading, 5)
assert(south.payload.kind, "pressure")
